import os
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
# produce grid
G=[[8]*18 for _ in range(14)]
G[0][16]=G[0][17]=2; G[13][5]=G[13][6]=2
for r,c in [(2,6),(6,5)]: G[r][c]=4
for r in range(1,14):
    if G[r][17]==8:G[r][17]=5
for r in range(0,13):
    if G[r][6]==8:G[r][6]=5
for r,c in [(2,6),(6,5)]:
    for rr in range(r+1,14):
        if G[rr][c]==8:G[rr][c]=5
# write function
src='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==5]
    # Two-cell markers on opposite borders specify parallel rays.
    top=[c for c in range(w) if g[0][c]==2]
    bot=[c for c in range(w) if g[h-1][c]==2]
    for r,c in pts:
        g[r][c]=4
        for rr in range(r+1,h):
            if g[rr][c]==8: g[rr][c]=5
    if top:
        c=max(top)
        for r in range(1,h):
            if g[r][c]==8: g[r][c]=5
    if bot:
        c=max(bot)
        for r in range(h-2,-1,-1):
            if g[r][c]==8: g[r][c]=5
    return g
'''
open(p,'w').write(src)
print(G)
